indexes.name: jobs_private.categories_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_pkey ON jobs_private.categories USING btree (code)

indexes.name: jobs_private.categories_sort_order_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_sort_order_key ON jobs_private.categories USING btree (sort_order)

indexes.name: jobs_private.requests_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX requests_pkey ON jobs_private.requests USING btree (actor_user_id, request_key)

indexes.name: public.jobs_owner_cursor_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_owner_cursor_idx ON public.jobs USING btree (identity_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)

indexes.name: public.jobs_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_pkey ON public.jobs USING btree (id)

indexes.name: public.jobs_profile_cursor_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_profile_cursor_idx ON public.jobs USING btree (identity_id, published_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (status = 'published'::text)

indexes.name: public.jobs_public_cursor_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_public_cursor_idx ON public.jobs USING btree (published_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (status = 'published'::text)

indexes.name: public.jobs_public_keywords_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_public_keywords_idx ON public.jobs USING gin (jobs_private.search_document(title, description, category, city, country_code)) WHERE (status = 'published'::text)

constraints.name: jobs_category_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (category) REFERENCES jobs_private.categories(code) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: jobs_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((salary_min IS NULL) OR (salary_max IS NULL) OR (salary_min <= salary_max)))

constraints.name: jobs_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((salary_min IS NOT NULL) OR (salary_max IS NOT NULL)) AND (salary_currency IS NOT NULL) AND (salary_period IS NOT NULL)) OR ((salary_min IS NULL) AND (salary_max IS NULL) AND (salary_currency IS NULL) AND (salary_period IS NULL))))

constraints.name: jobs_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'draft'::text) AND (published_at IS NULL) AND (active_until IS NULL) AND (last_confirmed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'draft'::text) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL) AND (active_until > published_at) AND ((last_confirmed_at IS NULL) OR (last_confirmed_at >= published_at)))))

constraints.name: jobs_identity_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (identity_id) REFERENCES public.identities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: jobs_task_content_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((employment_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'task'::text) OR (working_time IS NULL)) AND ((salary_period IS DISTINCT FROM 'task'::text) OR (NOT (employment_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'task'::text)))))
